verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents a non-interactive install mode labeled 'CI/CD friendly', using the -y flag with explicit --skill, -a and -g flags. It also offers `skills use`, which prints only the generated prompt to stdout so it can be piped into agents like claude, and it uses existing repo authentication for private sources. Lockfile-based restore via experimental_install supports reproducible automated setups, though it is experimental. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, documented exit codes and machine-readable output, and a stable (non-experimental) lockfile restore.
